_comment: Deployed to /data/huawei/driver.json. scales: current-scale policy per module serial (ratio1024 | x20 | x30 | conservative); ratio1024 (raw = A / nominal x 1024) CONFIRMED by clamp on E4308598A003 5..40 A and on 708A85B00972 at 1 A (2026-11-03). excluded: serials that are polled and published but never written to; 708A85B00972 (unit 1, R4875G5) caps itself at ~1.65 A whatever the limit (cause open) and must not take part in the allocation until that is solved. names: /CustomName defaults. display: board interface -> the serial of its unit and the address the board expects (USBCANFD DUAL channel 1 = can3 = board of charger 1; channel 0 = can2 = board of charger 2).
